capabilities: convert a Kindle highlights HTML file to Markdown
save highlights notes to a configurable folder
import highlights via a command palette command with a file picker
extras: The README documents the multi-step Kindle export process (export notebook as APA citation style) but shows no example of the generated note output.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn the HTML notebook files exported from the Kindle app into Markdown notes.
summary: Import plugin that converts a Kindle highlights HTML export into a Markdown note saved in a chosen vault folder.
